messages:
maya: Heads-up RFC follow-up — we need to finalize the model-pinning + rollout metadata shape before we land the console UX. Major constraints: must work for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private, must be queryable for audits, and must support gradual rollouts + forced pins.

arjun: +1. Can we avoid a million ad-hoc fields? prefer a minimal typed surface and an opaque metadata blob for extras.

sophia: Agreed. Also: we need strong typing for the core fields so DB indexes are useful for fast lookups (pin existence, active rollouts).

leo: Proposal idea: two-layer model: "pin" object (first class) + optional "rollout" objects (list). Pin = model_id, model_version (string), scope (org|route|key), expires_at (rfc3339 string|null), enforced (bool). Rollout = rollout_id, target_variant, percentage, start_ts, end_ts, fallback_policy.

maya: sketch that here for visibility:```json
{
  "pin": {
    "model_id": "redwood/ggml-7b",
    "model_version": "2025-02-14",
    "scope": "route:chat-completion",
    "expires_at": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z",
    "enforced": true
  },
  "rollouts": [
    {
      "rollout_id": "r-3a2f",
      "target_variant": "quantized-8bit",
      "percentage": 20,
      "start_ts": "2026-03-20T12:00:00Z",
      "end_ts": null,
      "fallback_policy": "soft-fallback"
    }
  ]
}
```

arjun: That looks clean. A few questions: 1) model_version type — do we require semver or allow arbitrary strings (git tags/dates)? 2) how to express compatibility (e.g., kv-cache incompatible)?

sophia: For speed, store model_version as opaque string in pins, but add an optional compatibility_flags list for the pin/variant (e.g., ["kv-incompatible", "requires-4k-cache"]). That lets routing logic check quickly.

leo: On semver: many of our upstream models use dates or git SHAs. Forcing semver will hurt. Keep string but add a normalized_hash (sha256 short) field computed by ingestion for deterministic equality checks/indexing.

maya: Good call. Also need to decide how "fallback_policy" maps to runtime: options: "hard-fail", "soft-fallback", "route-to-lower-tier". We need to ensure the policy is declarative but small set.

arjun: Implementation note: for Dedicated/Private, customers may want to pin to a local artifact id rather than a public model. Add an optional "artifact_source" with enum ("catalog","customer_artifact","external_url") and a freeform "artifact_ref" string.

sophia: Auditability: every pin/rollout mutation should record who made it, why, and a mut_id. Keep those in an append-only audit log. The live pin record should include last_mut_id to speed queries.

leo: Query patterns: Console will need to list "active pins for org X" and filter by route/expiry/enforced. So in DB we should denormalize: keep top-level columns: model_id, model_version, scope, enforced, expires_at, active_rollouts_count. The JSON blob stored in a metadata column for everything else.

maya: Tradeoff: denormalization speeds UI/queries but risks schema drift. We keep the core typed columns and a metadata JSONB for extensibility. That's our landing.

arjun: Backwards-compat: introduce schema_version on the pin object (v1). Runtime will accept v1 and v0 (legacy) for a migration window.

ops-team: deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: rollout-validator v1 -> staging @ 2026-03-22T03:00Z :gear: 

sophia: One more thing — runtime needs fast checks: when handling a request we must quickly find pinned model by route then check rollouts. Avoid scanning list-of-rollouts by storing an indexed active_rollout boolean on the pin.

leo: For gradual rollout hashing we should use a deterministic key: hash(user_id || route || rollout_id) % 100 < percentage. Documented in SDKs.

maya: Action items: 1) arjun: PR with DB migration (add core columns + metadata JSONB) 2) sophia: draft runtime guardrails for fallback enums and compatibility_flags 3) leo: docs for deterministic hashing and SDK snippet 4) ops-team: add audit ingestion to log pipeline.

arjun: I'll open the PR and tag reviewers. Will include sample migration SQL.

sophia: I'll write the compatibility flag table and tests.

leo: small nit — we should also store "created_via" (api/console/infra) to help usage insights.

maya: Excellent. If nobody objects I'll mark this as the agreed shape and iterate in the PR. :+1:

arjun: No objections from me.

sophia: LGTM.

ops-team: deploy-bot: reminder: add retention policy for audit logs (7 years for enterprise customers)

maya: Noted. We'll include retention in the rollout audit spec.

leo: Thanks everyone — closing out here, moving conversation into the PR comments for concrete diffs.

deploy-bot: changelog: created PR #3212 (pins: db + metadata)
